title: JSFL: selectNone, doc.save, doc.undo/redo, fl.undo/redo, doc.revert stubs + doc.duplicateSelection impl
description:
Add to packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts:

1. doc.selectNone(): void - clears selection: state.selectedIds = [] (or use existing selection setter). Add to JsflDocument interface + makeDocumentProxy.
2. doc.save(fileURL?: string): boolean - delegates to fl.saveDocument(this, fileURL) internally, or just calls exportSWF. Add to JsflDocument interface + proxy. Return true.
3. doc.undo(): void - console.warn('doc.undo: history managed at UI layer'). Add stub.
4. doc.redo(): void - same stub.
5. fl.undo(): void - console.warn stub. Add to JsflFl interface + makeFlProxy.
6. fl.redo(): void - same stub.
7. doc.revert(): void - console.warn('doc.revert: not supported') stub.
8. doc.duplicateSelection(): void - REAL implementation: get state.selectedIds, for each selected display object deep-copy it (JSON parse/stringify the displayObject or use a clone utility if one exists), assign new unique id, offset by {x+10, y+10}, add to current frame's displayObjects, update selection to the new copies. Look at how deleteSelection and addItem work to understand the model mutation pattern.
